query.sql:
SELECT entities.id, entities.kind, entities.engagement_id, entities.revision, entities.payload, entities.automation_run_id, entities.automation_session_id, entities.automation_status, entities.automation_expires_at, entities.chat_session_id, entities.artifact_tool_call_id, entities.tool_call_status, entities.tool_call_origin, entities.created_at, entities.updated_at 
FROM entities 
WHERE entities.kind = ? AND entities.chat_session_id = ? AND JSON_EXTRACT(entities.payload, ?) IN (?, ?, ?, ?) ORDER BY entities.created_at, entities.id
plan: SEARCH entities USING INDEX ix_entities_kind_chat_session_created (kind=? AND chat_session_id=?)
